# DECICE Green Computing — Carbon Intensity Forecasting API

> A FastAPI + Facebook Prophet REST API that forecasts hourly electricity-grid carbon intensity (gCO₂eq/kWh) for the North Italy (IT-NO) zone. It is part of the green / energy-efficient computing work of the DECICE EU Horizon Europe project (Grant Agreement No. 101092582), supporting carbon-aware workload scheduling across the cloud–edge–HPC continuum.

## What this project is

- Purpose: forecast grid carbon intensity so that compute workloads can be scheduled at low-carbon times (carbon-aware, energy-efficient computing).
- Region: North Italy electricity zone (IT-NO).
- Metric: carbon intensity in grams of CO₂-equivalent per kWh (gCO₂eq/kWh), hourly resolution.
- Model: a pre-trained Facebook Prophet time-series model (yearly, weekly, daily seasonality) trained on 2021–2024 hourly IT-NO history.
- Interface: a FastAPI HTTP service returning JSON.
- Language/stack: Python 3.12, FastAPI, Uvicorn, Prophet, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, matplotlib, Docker.

## Context: the DECICE project

- DECICE = Device-Edge-Cloud Intelligent Collaboration framEwork.
- Funding: European Union, Horizon Europe (HORIZON-CL4-2022-DATA-01-02), Grant Agreement No. 101092582.
- Goal: an AI-driven framework for scheduling and placing workloads across the heterogeneous cloud, edge and HPC compute continuum, with energy efficiency and sustainability as core objectives.
- This repository contributes carbon-intensity forecasting as an input signal for carbon-aware scheduling.

## API endpoints

- GET / — health check.
- GET /predictday — forecast for the next 24 hours.
- GET /predictweek — forecast for the next 7 days (168 hours).
- GET /predictmonth — forecast for the next 30 days (720 hours).
- GET /predictrange?start=<ISO>&end=<ISO> — forecast for a custom date range.

Each response is a JSON list of {"timestamp", "ci"} records, where "ci" is the forecasted carbon intensity in gCO₂eq/kWh.

## Usage

- Docker: `docker build -t decicegreencomputing .` then `docker run -p 8000:8000 decicegreencomputing`.
- Local: `pip install -r requirements.txt` then `uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000`.
- Interactive docs: http://localhost:8000/docs

## Key files

- app/main.py — FastAPI application and endpoints.
- app/model.py — model loading and forecast generation.
- app/train_model.py — trains and saves the Prophet model from IT-NO CSV history.
- app/dataset/IT-NO_<year>_hourly.csv — hourly carbon-intensity training data (2021–2024).
- Dockerfile — container build.
- requirements.txt — Python dependencies.
